tools.name: check_dmarc
tools.description: Check a domain's DMARC, SPF, and MX records. Use this to diagnose email authentication issues.

tools.name: check_email_health
tools.description: Get a 0-100 email health score for any domain. Checks DMARC, SPF, MX, and DKIM records and returns a letter grade (A+ to F) with actionable recommendations. Use this to audit any domain's email security posture.

tools.name: check_health
tools.description: Check ARC-Relay service health and uptime.

tools.name: check_spf
tools.description: Validate a domain's SPF record. Shows mechanisms, DNS lookup count, and warns if over the 10-lookup limit.

tools.name: network_leaderboard
tools.description: View top relay nodes ranked by reputation score. Filter by region.

tools.name: network_stats
tools.description: Get public relay network statistics — total nodes, active nodes, messages routed, delivery rate, DMARC pass rate.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_dmarc, check_email_health, network_stats · Private data: check_dmarc, check_email_health, check_spf · Public sink: check_dmarc, check_email_health.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_dmarc, check_email_health, network_stats · Private data: check_dmarc, check_email_health, check_spf · Public sink: check_dmarc, check_email_health

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
